sections.title: End-to-End Research Artifact
sections.body: Simulates **terrestrial + non-terrestrial network resilience** for under-connected and disrupted communities. > Research simulation — not operational NTN service claims. ---

sections.title: What is this?
sections.body: **Study service continuity when terrestrial links fail and NTN fallback matters for underserved or disrupted communities.**

sections.title: What problem does this solve?
sections.body: **Human:** Emergencies and rural gaps isolate people when one link fails. **Technical:** Need source-backed link budgets and fallback policies—not toy outage curves alone. **Who is harmed if unsolved:** Gary emergency users, rural Ghana/Guyana scenarios, humanitarian remote-first cases. **Gary / 7GC / digital equality:** This repo supports equitable connectivity research for under-connected communities; Gary is the f

sections.title: Beginner mental model
sections.body: A **backup generator for internet connectivity** when the main power line drops.

sections.title: How this repo addresses the problem
sections.body: Scenario YAML, CLI timelines, resilience metrics, Gary emergency config (assumption-based smoke). **Main output:** Outage timelines + resilience bundles in `results/e2e/`. **Output does NOT prove:** Validated NTN operator performance.

methods: # Reproducibility — NTN Resilience Simulator (RQ3) This repository produces **synthetic disruption/fallback timelines** under documented assumptions (3GPP TR 38.821 ranges plus configured/synthetic entries).
